## Frontend Rules (frontend/**)

- **MUI v9**: Style props (`fontWeight`, `textAlign`, `mb`, `mt`, `p`, etc.) are prohibited directly on components. Use `sx`.
- **Icons**: Use `*Outlined` icons (not `*Outline`).
- **React 19**: Use `React.SubmitEvent` or `React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLFormElement>` instead of deprecated `FormEvent`.
- **Apollo Client**: Import hooks exclusively from `@apollo/client/react`.
- **Theming**: No hardcoded color codes (hex, rgb). Access theme colors from `theme.palette`.
- **Logging**: Use `import { logger } from "@/frontend/utils/logger"`.
